title: Juicy Poached Tomato Stir-fry
description: A vibrant and healthy vegetarian dish featuring juicy poached tomatoes in a creamy sauce that can be served as a light dinner.

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.notes: double cream for a richer flavor

instructions: Cut tomatoes into slices and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle unsalted butter over the tomato slices, season lightly with salt and pepper, and bake for about 10 minutes or until slightly caramelized.
In a separate pan, melt remaining unsalted butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for about 2 minutes.
Remove tomatoes from oven and add them to the garlic in the saucepan. Mix well with cream cheese, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until all ingredients are evenly combined.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired before serving.
